Latest Independence Day collection from Rang Bangladesh
2018-03-20T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/latest-independence-day-collection-rang-bangladesh-1549963

Rang Bangladesh has brought out a new collection to commemorate the month of March. Block print, screen print as well as machine and hand embroidery are used extensively on the collection. For colours, various shades of red and green have been given prominence. Saris, panjabis, couple dresses etc. as well as clothes for children are part of this collection.

For more information, please visit www.rang-bd.com or call 01777744344
